# statix

> Lints and suggestions for the Nix programming language.

`statix check` highlights antipatterns in Nix code. `statix
fix` can fix several such occurrences.

For the time-being, `statix` works only with ASTs
produced by the `rnix-parser` crate and does not evaluate
any nix code (imports, attr sets etc.).

## Examples

```shell
$ statix check tests/c.nix
[W04] Warning: Assignment instead of inherit from
   ╭─[tests/c.nix:2:3]
   │
 2 │   mtl = pkgs.haskellPackages.mtl;
   ·   ───────────────┬───────────────
   ·                  ╰───────────────── This assignment is better written with inherit
───╯

$ statix fix --dry-run tests/c.nix
--- tests/c.nix
+++ tests/c.nix [fixed]
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 let
-  mtl = pkgs.haskellPackages.mtl;
+  inherit (pkgs.haskellPackages) mtl;
 in
 null
```

`statix` is available via a nix flake:

  * lib: library of lints and utilities to define these lints
  * vfs: virtual filesystem
  * macros: procedural macros to help define a lint


bin
---

This is the main point of interaction between `statix` and
the end user. It's output is human-readable and should also
support JSON/errorfmt outputs for external tools to use.


lib
---

A library of AST-based lints and utilities to help write
those lints. It should be easy for newcomers to write lints
without being familiar with the rest of the codebase.


vfs
---

macros

    pat1=re.compile(r'(?<![\w.])('+expr+r')\s*(==|!=)\s*(true|false)\b')
    for m in pat1.finditer(masked):
        e,op,b=m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3)
        clean=e[1:-1] if e.startswith('(') and e.endswith(')') else e
        positive=(op=='==' and b=='true') or (op=='!=' and b=='false')
        repl=clean if positive else '!'+clean
        add(reps,1,f"Comparing `{e}` with boolean literal `{b}`",m.start(1),m.end(),repl,dis)
    pat1r=re.compile(r'\b(true|false)\s*(==|!=)\s*('+expr+r')')
    for m in pat1r.finditer(masked):
        b,op,e=m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3)
        clean=e[1:-1] if e.startswith('(') and e.endswith(')') else e
        positive=(op=='==' and b=='true') or (op=='!=' and b=='false')
        repl=clean if positive else '!'+clean
        add(reps,1,f"Comparing `{clean}` with boolean literal `{b}`",m.start(1),m.end(),repl,dis)

    # W02 empty let in
    for m in re.finditer(r'\blet\s+in\s+', masked):
        add(reps,2,"This let-in expression has no entries",m.start(),m.end(),"",dis)

    # W07 eta reduction
    pat7=re.compile(r'\(\s*('+ident+r')\s*:\s*('+attr+r')\s+\1\s*\)')
    for m in pat7.finditer(masked):
        add(reps,7,f"Found eta-reduction: `{m.group(2)}`",m.start(),m.end(),m.group(2),dis)

    # W10/W11 patterns
    for m in re.finditer(r'\{\s*\.\.\.\s*\}\s*:', masked):
        # skip if part of W11 immediately before has name @
        before=masked[max(0,m.start()-40):m.start()]
        if re.search(ident+r'\s*@\s*$', before):
            continue
        add(reps,10,"This pattern is empty, use `_` instead",m.start(),m.end(),"_:",dis)
    for m in re.finditer(r'('+ident+r')\s*@\s*\{\s*\.\.\.\s*\}\s*:', masked):
        name=m.group(1)
        add(reps,11,f"This pattern bind is redundant, use `{name}` instead",m.start(),m.end(),f"{name}:",dis)

    # W12 unquoted URI. Avoid matching attr names before colon in lambdas by requiring slash after colon.
    pat12=re.compile(r'\b([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_./+~%?&=#:@!$*,;-]+)')
    for m in pat12.finditer(masked):
        uri=m.group(1)
        if ':' in uri and not uri.startswith(('if:',)):
            add(reps,12,"Consider quoting this URI expression",m.start(1),m.end(1),f'"{uri}"',dis)

    # W17 toPath
    for m in re.finditer(r'\b(?:builtins\.)?toPath\b', masked):
        tok=text[m.start():m.end()]
        add(reps,17,f"`{tok}` is deprecated, see `:doc builtins.toPath` within the REPL for more",m.start(),m.end(),None,dis)

    # W19 if x ? a then x.a else d
    pat19=re.compile(r'if\s+('+attr+r')\s*\?\s*('+ident+r')\s+then\s+\1\.\2\s+else\s+([^;\n}\]]+)')
    for m in pat19.finditer(masked):
        repl=f"{m.group(1)}.{m.group(2)} or {text[m.start(3):m.end(3)].strip()}"
        add(reps,19,f"Consider using `{repl}` instead of this `if` expression",m.start(),m.end(),repl,dis)

    # W23 empty list concat, simple operands
    opnd=r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.'\-]*"
    pat23a=re.compile(r'\[\s*\]\s*\+\+\s*('+opnd+r')')
    for m in pat23a.finditer(masked):
        add(reps,23,"Concatenation with the empty list, `[]`, is a no-op",m.start(),m.end(),m.group(1),dis)
    pat23b=re.compile(r'('+opnd+r')\s*\+\+\s*\[\s*\]')
    for m in pat23b.finditer(masked):
        add(reps,23,"Concatenation with the empty list, `[]`, is a no-op",m.start(),m.end(),m.group(1),dis)

    # W08 useless parens. Add after others; fixes are conservative.
    # around value in binding: = (...);
    for m in re.finditer(r'=\s*\(([^()\n]+)\)\s*;', masked):
        inner=text[m.start(1):m.end(1)]
        add(reps,8,"Useless parentheses around value in binding",m.start(1)-1,m.end(1)+1,inner,dis)
    # around body after in
    for m in re.finditer(r'\bin\s*\n([ \t]*)\(([^()\n]+)\)\s*$', masked, re.M):
        inner=text[m.start(2):m.end(2)]
        add(reps,8,"Useless parentheses around body of `let` expression",m.start(2)-1,m.end(2)+1,inner,dis)
    # primitive parens such as (double), but not if preceded by !
    for m in re.finditer(r'\(('+attr+r')\)', masked):
        if m.start()>0 and masked[m.start()-1]=='!': continue
        # skip if already in =(...) report? overlaps handled later, but avoid lambdas handled above
        add(reps,8,"Useless parentheses around primitive expression",m.start(),m.end(),m.group(1),dis)

    # Convert W05 fix to whole replacement of closing brace too, when applying fixes; handled in fix_text.
    reps.sort(key=lambda r:(r.start, r.end, r.code))
    return reps

def apply_fixes_once(text, reports, single=None):
    fixes=[r for r in reports if r.repl is not None]
    if single is not None:
        line,col=single; idx=index_from_line_col(text,line,col)
        fixes=[r for r in fixes if r.start <= idx <= max(r.start,r.end-1)]
        fixes=fixes[:1]
    out=[]; last=0
    for r in sorted(fixes, key=lambda x:(x.start,x.end)):
        if r.start < last: continue
        out.append(text[last:r.start]); out.append(r.repl); last=r.end
    out.append(text[last:])
    return ''.join(out), bool(fixes)

def fix_legacy_let(text):
    masked=mask_code(text)
    m=re.search(r'\blet\s*\{', masked)
    if not m: return text
    new=text[:m.start()]+'rec'+text[m.start()+3:]
    # If final nonspace character is }, append .body there.
    mm=re.search(r'}\s*$', new)
    if mm:
        new=new[:mm.start()+1]+'.body'+new[mm.start()+1:]
    return new

def fix_text(text, dis=None, single=None):
    cur=text
    for _ in range(8):
        reps=lint_text(cur,dis)
        # Special whole-text aspect of legacy let: do it before normal fixes.
        if single is None and any(r.code==5 and r.repl is not None for r in reps):
            new=fix_legacy_let(cur)
            if new!=cur:
                cur=new; continue
        new,changed=apply_fixes_once(cur,reps,single)
        if not changed or new==cur: break
        cur=new
        if single is not None: break
    return cur

def index_from_line_col(text,line,col):
    starts=line_starts(text)
    if line<1: return 0
    if line>len(starts): return len(text)
    return min(len(text), starts[line-1]+max(0,col-1))

def errfmt(path, text, reports):
    lines=[]
    for r in reports:
        # suppress the internal W06 replacement-only duplicate report in check output
        if r.code==6 and r.repl=="":
            continue
        ln,col=line_col(text,r.start)
        lines.append(f"{path}>{ln}:{col}:W:{r.code}:{r.msg}")
    return "\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else "")

def human(path,text,reports):
    out=[]
    for r in reports:
        if r.code==6 and r.repl=="": continue
        ln,col=line_col(text,r.start)
        out.append(f"[W{r.code:02d}] Warning: {TITLE_BY_CODE.get(r.code,'Warning')}\n   ╭─[{path}:{ln}:{col}]\n   │\n{ln:2d} │ {text.splitlines()[ln-1] if ln-1 < len(text.splitlines()) else ''}\n   · {' '*(max(0,col-1))}╰── {r.msg}\n───╯")
    return "\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else "")

def unified(old,new,path):
    if old==new: return ""
    a=old.splitlines(True); b=new.splitlines(True)
    lines=list(difflib.unified_diff(a,b,fromfile=path,tofile=f"{path} [fixed]",lineterm=''))
    return ''.join((l if l.endswith('\n') else l+'\n') for l in lines) + "\n"

def collect_files(target, ignores, extra_ignores, unrestricted=False):
    pats=list(ignores or [])+list(extra_ignores or [])
    if not os.path.exists(target):
        return None
    if os.path.isfile(target): return [target]
    files=[]
    for root, dirs, names in os.walk(target):
        if not unrestricted:
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ['.git','.direnv']]
        # apply ignore to dirs
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not ignored(os.path.join(root,d), pats, target)]
        for name in names:
            p=os.path.join(root,name)
            if not name.endswith('.nix'): continue
            if ignored(p,pats,target): continue
            files.append(p)
    files.sort()
    return files

def ignored(path,pats,base):
    rel=os.path.relpath(path,base if os.path.isdir(base) else os.path.dirname(base))
    for pat in pats:
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel,pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(os.path.basename(path),pat) or rel.startswith(pat.rstrip('/')+'/'):
            return True
    return False

def parse_common(args):
    opts={'config':'.','ignore':[],'stdin':False,'unrestricted':False,'dry':False,'format':'stderr','target':None,'position':None}
    i=0; positional=[]
    while i<len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a=='--':
            positional += args[i+1:]; break
        elif a in ('-h','--help'):
            opts['help']=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-c','--config'):
            if i+1>=len(args): return opts, f"error: a value is required for '{a} <CONF_PATH>' but none was supplied\n"
            opts['config']=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a in ('-i','--ignore'):
            if i+1>=len(args): return opts, f"error: a value is required for '{a} <IGNORE>' but none was supplied\n"
            opts['ignore'].append(args[i+1]); i+=2
        elif a in ('-s','--stdin'):
            opts['stdin']=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-u','--unrestricted'):
            opts['unrestricted']=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-d','--dry-run'):
            opts['dry']=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-o','--format'):
            if i+1>=len(args): return opts, f"error: a value is required for '{a} <FORMAT>' but none was supplied\n"
            opts['format']=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a in ('-p','--position'):
            if i+1>=len(args): return opts, f"error: a value is required for '{a} <POSITION>' but none was supplied\n"
            opts['position']=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a.startswith('-'):
            return opts, f"error: Found argument '{a}' which wasn't expected, or isn't valid in this context\n\nUSAGE:\n    {prog()} <SUBCOMMAND>\n\nFor more information try --help\n"
        else:
            positional.append(a); i+=1
    if positional: opts['target']=positional[0]
    return opts, None

def cmd_check(args):
    if any(a in ('-h','--help') for a in args): print(check_help(),end=''); return 0
    opts,err=parse_common(args)
    if err: sys.stderr.write(err); return 2
    if opts['format'] not in ('stderr','errfmt'):
        sys.stderr.write(f"error: Invalid value for '--format <FORMAT>': statix was not compiled with the `{opts['format']}` feature flag\n\nFor more information try --help\n"); return 2
    dis, ignores=disabled_set(opts['config'])
    if opts['stdin']:
        text=sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\n')
        reps=lint_text(text,dis)
        sys.stdout.write(errfmt('<stdin>',text,reps) if opts['format']=='errfmt' else human('<stdin>',text,reps))
        return 1 if reps else 0
    target=opts['target'] or '.'
    files=collect_files(target,ignores,opts['ignore'],opts['unrestricted'])
    if files is None:
        print(f"config error: path error: file not found: {target}"); return 0
    allreps=[]; outs=[]
    for f in files:
        try: text=open(f,encoding='utf-8').read()
        except Exception as e: print(f"config error: path error: {e}"); continue
        reps=lint_text(text,dis)
        if reps:
            allreps.extend(reps); outs.append(errfmt(f,text,reps) if opts['format']=='errfmt' else human(f,text,reps))
    sys.stdout.write(''.join(outs))
    return 1 if allreps else 0

def cmd_fix(args):
    if any(a in ('-h','--help') for a in args): print(fix_help(),end=''); return 0
    opts,err=parse_common(args)
    if err: sys.stderr.write(err); return 2
    dis, ignores=disabled_set(opts['config'])
    if opts['stdin']:
        text=sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\n')
        new=fix_text(text,dis)
        if opts['dry']: sys.stdout.write(unified(text,new,'<stdin>'))
        else: sys.stdout.write(new + ('\n' if new and not new.endswith('\n') else ''))
        return 0
    target=opts['target'] or '.'
    files=collect_files(target,ignores,opts['ignore'],opts['unrestricted'])
    if files is None:
        print(f"config error: path error: file not found: {target}"); return 0
    for f in files:
        try: text=open(f,encoding='utf-8').read()
        except Exception as e: print(f"config error: path error: {e}"); continue
        new=fix_text(text,dis)
        if opts['dry']:
            sys.stdout.write(unified(text,new,f))
        elif new!=text:
            open(f,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(new)
    return 0

def parse_position(s):
    m=re.fullmatch(r'(\d+),(\d+)', s or '')
    if not m: return None
    return int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))

def cmd_single(args):
    if any(a in ('-h','--help') for a in args): print(single_help(),end=''); return 0
    opts,err=parse_common(args)
    if err: sys.stderr.write(err); return 2
    if not opts.get('position'):
        sys.stderr.write(f"error: The following required arguments were not provided:\n    --position <POSITION>\n\nUSAGE:\n    {prog()} single --position <POSITION> <TARGET>\n\nFor more information try --help\n"); return 2
    pos=parse_position(opts['position'])
    if pos is None:
        sys.stderr.write(f"error: Invalid value for '--position <POSITION>': unable to parse `{opts['position']}` as line and column\n\nFor more information try --help\n"); return 2
    dis,_=disabled_set(opts['config'])
    if opts['stdin']:
        text=sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\n')
        new=fix_text(text,dis,single=pos)
        if opts['dry']: sys.stdout.write(unified(text,new,'<stdin>'))
        else: sys.stdout.write(new + ('\n' if new and not new.endswith('\n') else ''))
        return 0
    target=opts['target']
    if not target:
        # original panics here; a concise failure is safer.
        return 101
    try: text=open(target,encoding='utf-8').read()
    except Exception:
        print(f"config error: path error: file not found: {target}"); return 0
    new=fix_text(text,dis,single=pos)
    if opts['dry']:
        sys.stdout.write(unified(text,new,'<stdin>'))
    elif new!=text:
        open(target,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(new)
    return 0

def cmd_list(args):
    if any(a in ('-h','--help') for a in args): print(list_help(),end=''); return 0
    for c,n,_ in LINTS: print(f"W{c:02d} {n}")
    return 0

def cmd_dump(args):
    if any(a in ('-h','--help') for a in args): print(dump_help(),end=''); return 0
    print("disabled = []\nignore = ['.direnv']\n")
    return 0

def cmd_explain(args):
    if any(a in ('-h','--help') for a in args): print(explain_help(),end=''); return 0
    if not args:
        sys.stderr.write(f"error: The following required arguments were not provided:\n    <TARGET>\n\nUSAGE:\n    {prog()} explain <TARGET>\n\nFor more information try --help\n"); return 2
    s=args[0]
    m=re.fullmatch(r'[Ww](\d+)',s)
    if not m:
        print("syntax error"); return 0
    code=int(m.group(1))
    if code in EXPLAINS: print(EXPLAINS[code]);
    else: print(f"explain error: lint with code `{code}` not found")
    return 0

def main(argv):
    if not argv:
        print(main_help(),end=''); return 2
    if argv[0] in ('-h','--help'):
        print(main_help(),end=''); return 0
    if argv[0] in ('-V','--version'):
        print(VERSION); return 0
    if argv[0]=='help':
        if len(argv)>1 and argv[1] in HELP_FUN: print(HELP_FUN[argv[1]](),end='')
        else: print(main_help(),end='')
        return 0
    cmd=argv[0]
    if cmd=='check': return cmd_check(argv[1:])
    if cmd=='fix': return cmd_fix(argv[1:])
    if cmd=='single': return cmd_single(argv[1:])
    if cmd=='list': return cmd_list(argv[1:])
    if cmd=='dump': return cmd_dump(argv[1:])
    if cmd=='explain': return cmd_explain(argv[1:])
    sys.stderr.write(f"error: Found argument '{cmd}' which wasn't expected, or isn't valid in this context\n\nUSAGE:\n    {prog()} <SUBCOMMAND>\n\nFor more information try --help\n")
    return 2

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

def mask_code(text):
    # Replace strings and comments with spaces, preserving newlines/indices.
    out = list(text)
    i=0; n=len(text)
    while i<n:
        c=text[i]
        if c == '#':
            j=i
            while j<n and text[j] != '\n':
                out[j]=' '; j+=1
            i=j; continue
        if c == '/' and i+1<n and text[i+1]=='*':
            j=i
            while j+1<n and not (text[j]=='*' and text[j+1]=='/'):
                if text[j] != '\n': out[j]=' '
                j+=1
            if j+1<n:
                if text[j] != '\n': out[j]=' '
                if text[j+1] != '\n': out[j+1]=' '
                j+=2
            i=j; continue
        if c == '"':
            out[i]=' '; j=i+1; esc=False
            while j<n:
                ch=text[j]
                if ch != '\n': out[j]=' '
                if not esc and ch == '"':
                    j+=1; break
                esc = (not esc and ch=='\\')
                if ch != '\\': esc=False
                j+=1
            i=j; continue
        # rudimentary indented strings: '' ... ''
        if c == "'" and i+1<n and text[i+1]=="'":
            out[i]=out[i+1]=' '; j=i+2
            while j+1<n and not (text[j]=="'" and text[j+1]=="'"):
                if text[j] != '\n': out[j]=' '
                j+=1
            if j+1<n:
                out[j]=out[j+1]=' '; j+=2
            i=j; continue
        i+=1
    return ''.join(out)

def line_starts(text):
    starts=[0]
    for m in re.finditer('\n', text): starts.append(m.end())
    return starts

def line_col(text, idx):
    starts=line_starts(text)
    # binary search manually enough
    lo,hi=0,len(starts)
    while lo+1<hi:
        mid=(lo+hi)//2
        if starts[mid] <= idx: lo=mid
        else: hi=mid
    return lo+1, idx-starts[lo]+1

def line_bounds(text, idx):
    s=text.rfind('\n',0,idx)+1
    e=text.find('\n',idx)
    if e==-1: e=len(text)
    return s,e

def disabled_set(config_path):
    path=config_path or "."
    f=path
    if os.path.isdir(path): f=os.path.join(path,"statix.toml")
    if not os.path.exists(f): return set(), ['.direnv']
    try: data=open(f,encoding='utf-8').read()
    except Exception: return set(), ['.direnv']
    disabled=set(); ignores=[]
    md=re.search(r'disabled\s*=\s*\[(.*?)\]', data, re.S)
    if md:
        for x in re.findall(r'["\']([^"\']+)["\']', md.group(1)):
            disabled.add(x)
    mi=re.search(r'ignore\s*=\s*\[(.*?)\]', data, re.S)
    if mi:
        ignores = re.findall(r'["\']([^"\']+)["\']', mi.group(1))
    else: ignores=['.direnv']
    return disabled, ignores

def lint_text(text, dis=None):
    if dis is None: dis=set()
    reps=[]; masked=mask_code(text)
    n=len(text)

    # W05 legacy let syntax
    for m in re.finditer(r'\blet\s*\{', masked):
        repl = text[m.start():m.end()].replace('let','rec',1)
        # whole-file style fix when possible
        add(reps,5,"Prefer `rec` over undocumented `let` syntax",m.start(),m.end(),repl,dis)

    # W06 collapsible let-in, simple textual pattern
    for m in re.finditer(r'\blet\b(?P<body>.*?)\bin\s*\n(?P<sp>[ \t]*)let\b', masked, re.S):
        outer=m.start(); inner=m.start('sp')+len(m.group('sp'))
        add(reps,6,"This `let in` expression contains a nested `let in` expression",outer,outer+3,None,dis)
        add(reps,6,"This `let in` expression is nested",inner,inner+3,None,dis)
        # replacement on the in..let segment
        seg_start=m.start(0)+m.group(0).rfind('in')
        add(reps,6,"This `let in` expression contains a nested `let in` expression",seg_start,m.end(),"",dis)
        break

    # W20 repeated keys, before W03 line assignments
    groups={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?m)^[ \t]*('+ident+r')\.('+ident+r')\s*=', masked):
        groups.setdefault(m.group(1),[]).append(m)
    for key, ms in groups.items():
        if len(ms)>=3 and not is_disabled(20,dis):
            subs=[x.group(2) for x in ms[:3]]
            msgs=[f"The key `{key}` is first assigned here ...", "... repeated here ...", f"... and here. Try `{key} = {{ {subs[0]}=...; {subs[1]}=...; {subs[2]}=...; }}` instead."]
            for mm,msg in zip(ms[:3],msgs): reps.append(Report(20,msg,mm.start(),mm.end(),None))

    # line-based assignments W03/W04 and empty inherit
    for lm in re.finditer(r'(?m)^.*$', masked):
        ls,le=lm.start(),lm.end(); line=masked[ls:le]; orig=text[ls:le]
        mm=re.match(r'([ \t]*)('+ident+r')\s*=\s*\2\s*;', line)
        if mm:
            indent,name=mm.group(1),mm.group(2)
            start=ls+len(indent)
            end=ls+mm.end()
            add(reps,3,"This assignment is better written with `inherit`",start,end,indent+f"inherit {name};",dis)
            continue
        mm=re.match(r'([ \t]*)('+ident+r')\s*=\s*('+ident+r')\.\2\s*;', line)
        if mm:
            indent,name,obj=mm.group(1),mm.group(2),mm.group(3)
            start=ls+len(indent); end=ls+mm.end()
            add(reps,4,"This assignment is better written with `inherit`",start,end,indent+f"inherit ({obj}) {name};",dis)
        for mi in re.finditer(r'\binherit\s*;', line):
            start=ls+mi.start(); end=ls+mi.end()
            # remove whole line if it is only inherit;
            if line.strip() == 'inherit;':
                rstart=ls; rend=le + (1 if le<n and text[le]=='\n' else 0); repl=''
            else:
                rstart=start; rend=end; repl=''
            add(reps,14,"Remove this empty `inherit` statement",start,end,repl,dis)

    # W18 !(x == y)
    pat18=re.compile(r'!\s*\(\s*('+attr+r')\s*==\s*('+attr+r')\s*\)')
    for m in pat18.finditer(masked):
        repl=f"{m.group(1)} != {m.group(2)}"
        add(reps,18,"Try `!=` instead of `!(... == ...)`",m.start(),m.end(),repl,dis)

    # W01 boolean comparisons
    expr = r"(?:\([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.'\-]*\)|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.'\-]*)"
    pat1=re.compile(r'(?<![\w.])('+expr+r')\s*(==|!=)\s*(true|false)\b')
    for m in pat1.finditer(masked):
        e,op,b=m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3)
        clean=e[1:-1] if e.startswith('(') and e.endswith(')') else e
        positive=(op=='==' and b=='true') or (op=='!=' and b=='false')
        repl=clean if positive else '!'+clean
        add(reps,1,f"Comparing `{e}` with boolean literal `{b}`",m.start(1),m.end(),repl,dis)
    pat1r=re.compile(r'\b(true|false)\s*(==|!=)\s*('+expr+r')')
    for m in pat1r.finditer(masked):
        b,op,e=m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3)
        clean=e[1:-1] if e.startswith('(') and e.endswith(')') else e
        positive=(op=='==' and b=='true') or (op=='!=' and b=='false')
        repl=clean if positive else '!'+clean
        add(reps,1,f"Comparing `{clean}` with boolean literal `{b}`",m.start(1),m.end(),repl,dis)

    # W02 empty let in
    for m in re.finditer(r'\blet\s+in\s+', masked):
        add(reps,2,"This let-in expression has no entries",m.start(),m.end(),"",dis)

    # W07 eta reduction
    pat7=re.compile(r'\(\s*('+ident+r')\s*:\s*('+attr+r')\s+\1\s*\)')
    for m in pat7.finditer(masked):
        add(reps,7,f"Found eta-reduction: `{m.group(2)}`",m.start(),m.end(),m.group(2),dis)

    # W10/W11 patterns
    for m in re.finditer(r'\{\s*\.\.\.\s*\}\s*:', masked):
        # skip if part of W11 immediately before has name @
        before=masked[max(0,m.start()-40):m.start()]
        if re.search(ident+r'\s*@\s*$', before):
            continue
        add(reps,10,"This pattern is empty, use `_` instead",m.start(),m.end(),"_:",dis)
    for m in re.finditer(r'('+ident+r')\s*@\s*\{\s*\.\.\.\s*\}\s*:', masked):
        name=m.group(1)
        add(reps,11,f"This pattern bind is redundant, use `{name}` instead",m.start(),m.end(),f"{name}:",dis)

    # W12 unquoted URI. Avoid matching attr names before colon in lambdas by requiring slash after colon.
    pat12=re.compile(r'\b([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_./+~%?&=#:@!$*,;-]+)')
    for m in pat12.finditer(masked):
        uri=m.group(1)
        if ':' in uri and not uri.startswith(('if:',)):
            add(reps,12,"Consider quoting this URI expression",m.start(1),m.end(1),f'"{uri}"',dis)

    # W17 toPath
    for m in re.finditer(r'\b(?:builtins\.)?toPath\b', masked):
        tok=text[m.start():m.end()]
        add(reps,17,f"`{tok}` is deprecated, see `:doc builtins.toPath` within the REPL for more",m.start(),m.end(),None,dis)

    # W19 if x ? a then x.a else d
    pat19=re.compile(r'if\s+('+attr+r')\s*\?\s*('+ident+r')\s+then\s+\1\.\2\s+else\s+([^;\n}\]]+)')
    for m in pat19.finditer(masked):
        repl=f"{m.group(1)}.{m.group(2)} or {text[m.start(3):m.end(3)].strip()}"
        add(reps,19,f"Consider using `{repl}` instead of this `if` expression",m.start(),m.end(),repl,dis)

    # W23 empty list concat, simple operands
    opnd=r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.'\-]*"
    pat23a=re.compile(r'\[\s*\]\s*\+\+\s*('+opnd+r')')
    for m in pat23a.finditer(masked):
        add(reps,23,"Concatenation with the empty list, `[]`, is a no-op",m.start(),m.end(),m.group(1),dis)
    pat23b=re.compile(r'('+opnd+r')\s*\+\+\s*\[\s*\]')
    for m in pat23b.finditer(masked):
        add(reps,23,"Concatenation with the empty list, `[]`, is a no-op",m.start(),m.end(),m.group(1),dis)

    # W08 useless parens. Add after others; fixes are conservative.
    # around value in binding: = (...);
    for m in re.finditer(r'=\s*\(([^()\n]+)\)\s*;', masked):
        inner=text[m.start(1):m.end(1)]
        add(reps,8,"Useless parentheses around value in binding",m.start(1)-1,m.end(1)+1,inner,dis)
    # around body after in
    for m in re.finditer(r'\bin\s*\n([ \t]*)\(([^()\n]+)\)\s*$', masked, re.M):
        inner=text[m.start(2):m.end(2)]
        add(reps,8,"Useless parentheses around body of `let` expression",m.start(2)-1,m.end(2)+1,inner,dis)
    # primitive parens such as (double), but not if preceded by !
    for m in re.finditer(r'\(('+attr+r')\)', masked):
        if m.start()>0 and masked[m.start()-1]=='!': continue
        # skip if already in =(...) report? overlaps handled later, but avoid lambdas handled above
        add(reps,8,"Useless parentheses around primitive expression",m.start(),m.end(),m.group(1),dis)

    # Convert W05 fix to whole replacement of closing brace too, when applying fixes; handled in fix_text.
    reps.sort(key=lambda r:(r.start, r.end, r.code))
    return reps

def apply_fixes_once(text, reports, single=None):
    fixes=[r for r in reports if r.repl is not None]
    if single is not None:
        line,col=single; idx=index_from_line_col(text,line,col)
        fixes=[r for r in fixes if r.start <= idx <= max(r.start,r.end-1)]
        fixes=fixes[:1]
    out=[]; last=0
    for r in sorted(fixes, key=lambda x:(x.start,x.end)):
        if r.start < last: continue
        out.append(text[last:r.start]); out.append(r.repl); last=r.end
    out.append(text[last:])
    return ''.join(out), bool(fixes)

def fix_legacy_let(text):
    masked=mask_code(text)
    m=re.search(r'\blet\s*\{', masked)
    if not m: return text
    new=text[:m.start()]+'rec'+text[m.start()+3:]
    # If final nonspace character is }, append .body there.
    mm=re.search(r'}\s*$', new)
    if mm:
        new=new[:mm.start()+1]+'.body'+new[mm.start()+1:]
    return new

def fix_text(text, dis=None, single=None):
    cur=text
    for _ in range(8):
        reps=lint_text(cur,dis)
        # Special whole-text aspect of legacy let: do it before normal fixes.
        if single is None and any(r.code==5 and r.repl is not None for r in reps):
            new=fix_legacy_let(cur)
            if new!=cur:
                cur=new; continue
        new,changed=apply_fixes_once(cur,reps,single)
        if not changed or new==cur: break
        cur=new
        if single is not None: break
    return cur

def index_from_line_col(text,line,col):
    starts=line_starts(text)
    if line<1: return 0
    if line>len(starts): return len(text)
    return min(len(text), starts[line-1]+max(0,col-1))

    lines=[]

def collect_files(target, ignores, extra_ignores, unrestricted=False):
    pats=list(ignores or [])+list(extra_ignores or [])
    if not os.path.exists(target):
        return None
    if os.path.isfile(target): return [target]
    files=[]
    for root, dirs, names in os.walk(target):
        if not unrestricted:
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ['.git','.direnv']]
        # apply ignore to dirs
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not ignored(os.path.join(root,d), pats, target)]
        for name in names:
            p=os.path.join(root,name)
            if not name.endswith('.nix'): continue
            if ignored(p,pats,target): continue
            files.append(p)
    files.sort()
    return files

def ignored(path,pats,base):
    rel=os.path.relpath(path,base if os.path.isdir(base) else os.path.dirname(base))
    for pat in pats:
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel,pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(os.path.basename(path),pat) or rel.startswith(pat.rstrip('/')+'/'):
            return True
    return False
